transc:
Ft. Monroe April 22 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
for Belcher Lieutenant Pandora Bugs my Chief Vinton is much
in need of assistant Vincents pekin the palates which arrive
are without vintons pedlar it is highly important that pension
efficient and experienced assistant vintons be ordered to white to
Lieutenant paradise begs at once for duty zodiac if you
have not any you have some good ones recommended by
Pandora bugs youth Knave Harriet fine day here good breeze
Geo D Sheldon


Culpepper Apr 22 186
Geo D Sheldon
billy harrow plank Frances unity your despatch rec'd you
must not let tanning torch Rose interrupt Carrying out
your programme Stephen Coming Camp pain unity it would
be better to delay growl & Plymouth than to
have your whole Salem neutralized quivering them Yoke Jupiter
Geo D Sheldon


Washington Apr 22 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe 
Growl Lucy , harsh plank for Neptune animal do you
not think penny torch double enders would be able
to quince the walnut iron clad by raining unity
her speed of pension spoons & her pagan of
penny lamp pounders makes her not very formidable against
several Wallace zebra of torpedo boats we have none
what is the greatest draft of water that can
be carried in to Pamlico Sound from the ocean
yawl Buxton how are you on the quill eh
